minimal_common_fix.admission: Retain only prior selected-core condition/use units whose condition is root offset0 or an explicitly selected first enemy reply at offset1 in the original completionSources.actionReferences, on the exact currently owned pair path with certified first enemy mover.
seams: RootSubjectComparison.protect conditionUses filter accepts a bounded selectedReplies whitelist.
MoveWorkProjection.protectRootUses derives the whitelist once from original explicit completion sources, and applies the identical whitelist when closing retained uses.
minimal_common_fix.closure: Use existing comparisonAccount for the selected capture user and unchanged conditions/prices/check/ending closure, including section-level fail-closed fallback. Freeze original retained use/action/boundary sources; newly added prices cannot become new selected reply conditions.
minimal_common_fix.does_not_admit: No arbitrary future action, all raw-history price, unselected context first reply, unknown actor, foreign history, or newly generated price seed.
minimal_common_fix.why_necessary: The prior core proves a first-reply clearance consequence, while the compact lead deliberately keeps that first reply. A root0-only condition filter cannot carry its owned use.
minimal_common_fix.why_bounded_sufficient: The exact same owned 1→5 use already exists in previous.core and current explicit completion sources own departure1. Existing capture account has the price and complete positions. No new investigation or explanation mechanism is required.

regression_requirement.positive: Replay unchanged actual COR03 reports/whole issued keys under current source; retain first_target_response and core explicit axb3@1 plus exact Rxa2@5 covered MoveRef, original Ra8/Pa2 identity, check/reply/prices and whole numeric judgment.
negative_controls: Historical C18 Qa5/Qc7 branch prices at14/15 must not become core merely because a full path is kept as discovery/context.
An old COR08 Bg3-history first reply not owned by current completionSources must not import its old Nxd4/Qxd4 prices.
A manufactured future or price-generated condition source must not enlarge selectedReplies.
Missing position or incomplete account must retain existing section-level episode fallback rather than hide a required price.

limitations: The separate audit distinguishes current dependencies from the immutable original34 retention metric; it does not reclassify any old-history omission as success.
Current selected prices on a different history do not substitute for original exact refs.
No private typed core dump or product replay was run by this auditor in this step.
The identified common repair remains proposed until its actual red/green regression and replay are performed by the parent.
